sql: WITH r AS (SELECT company_id, lead_id, min(coalesce(sent_at, created_at)) AS primeiro_envio, bool_or(status = 'replied') AS respondeu FROM lead_reactivation_history WHERE status IN ('sent', 'replied') GROUP BY 1, 2), f AS (SELECT r.*, l.status AS status_atual, (SELECT min(h.created_at) FROM lead_history h WHERE h.lead_id = r.lead_id AND h.created_at >= r.primeiro_envio AND (h.new_value ILIKE '%fechado%')) AS fechou_em FROM r JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = r.lead_id) SELECT co.name AS empresa, count(*) AS leads_reativados, sum(CASE WHEN respondeu THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS responderam, sum(CASE WHEN status_atual = 'fechado' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fechados_hoje, sum(CASE WHEN status_atual = 'fechado' AND fechou_em IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fechados_depois_da_reativacao, sum(CASE WHEN status_atual = 'fechado' AND fechou_em IS NOT NULL AND respondeu THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fechados_que_responderam FROM f JOIN companies co ON co.id = f.company_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
